[d5] (Forbes) also discusses gene therapy as a potential cure, quoting a patient describing what "a cure will mean for individuals who are able to achieve that through gene therapy."

In summary, the established medical consensus from multiple credible institutions [d1][d3][d6][d7][d9] holds that hemophilia has no confirmed cure at present, while emerging gene therapy research [d2][d4][d5] suggests a cure may be achievable, creating a genuine conflict between current consensus and cutting-edge research outcomes.
